name: László Kovács
bio:
László Kovács's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering, spending hours tinkering with engines alongside his father, a local mechanic. This hands-on experience ignited a passion that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, László joined a small Hungarian racing team, where he honed his skills in vehicle testing and data analysis.

His dedication and sharp analytical mind caught the attention of Toyota Gazoo Racing, who recruited him as a test driver coordinator. László excels at organizing and overseeing comprehensive testing programs, ensuring that every detail is meticulously analyzed to optimize performance. He possesses a keen eye for spotting subtle issues and communicating them effectively to the engineering team, making him an invaluable asset in the development of cutting-edge racing technology. His calm demeanor and methodical approach ensure that all testing is conducted efficiently and effectively, even under the immense pressure of competitive motorsport.

László's perfectionism drives him to constantly seek improvements, always striving to extract the maximum potential from both the vehicles and the drivers. He's known for his ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights, fostering a collaborative environment between engineers and drivers to achieve optimal results.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: László is of medium height with a slightly stocky build, often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using only Hungarian-made coffee in the test garage.
